format.notes: Dry voice only. No reverb, music or effects; peaks under -3 dBFS; trim silence to ~50 ms. Effects are added in the mix.

archivist.role: M.E.G. archivist (same narrator in every episode)
archivist.voice: Adult, neutral-to-low voice, any gender. Flat, clinical, measured. Must be the SAME voice as earlier episodes.

bart_post.role: u/Bart0nius reading his own forum post (voice-over over the post on screen). A member of the missing Explorers group who fell through the floor of Level 8.
bart_post.voice: Man, early 20s, casual, a little too calm — he half believes it's a dream. Dry, close, slightly dazed.

bart.role: Bart0nius on his phone's camera mic, walking the street at midnight.
bart.voice: SAME voice as bart_post. Whispering or speaking very low most of the time; breathing audible; increasingly scared.

bart_last.role: Bart0nius, final words before the recording corrupts.
bart_last.voice: SAME voice as bart_post. Resolved, shaky, out of breath.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: M.E.G. 档案，补充材料 9-B。以下帖子与视频来自失踪的「探险者」小组成员 Bart0nius。
lines.en: M.E.G. archive, supplement 9-B. The following post and video are from Bart0nius, a member of the missing Explorers group.
lines.tts_text: M.E.G.档案，补充材料九B。以下帖子与视频，来自失踪的探险者小组成员，巴特。
lines.direction: Clinical, as always.

lines.speaker: bart_post
lines.subtitle: 「我在八层掉穿了地板。现在在一个小区里。是晚上。我觉得我在做梦。」
lines.en: “Fell through the floor in Level 8. I'm in a neighbourhood. It's night. I think I'm dreaming.”
lines.tts_text: 我在八层掉穿了地板。现在在一个小区里。是晚上。我觉得，我在做梦。
lines.direction: Reading what he typed, flat, a slightly dazed half-laugh on 'dreaming'.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「……喂？有人吗？」
lines.en: “…Hello? Anyone?”
lines.tts_text: ……喂？有人吗？
lines.direction: Lying on wet asphalt, just come to. Hoarse, not loud. Second word quieter, as if he regrets calling out.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: Level 9，「郊区」。生存难度：五级。一片永远停在午夜、没有尽头的郊区。
lines.en: Level 9, “The Suburbs.” Survival difficulty: 5. An infinite suburb, stopped forever at midnight.
lines.tts_text: Level 9，郊区。生存难度，五级。一片永远停在午夜、没有尽头的郊区。
lines.direction: Clinical.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「每栋房子都不一样……里面家具都是新的。可是什么都通不了电。」
lines.en: “Every house is different… The furniture's new. But nothing turns on.”
lines.tts_text: 每栋房子都不一样……里面家具都是新的。可是，什么都通不了电。
lines.direction: Whispering, peering through a window with his phone light.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 房子各不相同，家具齐全，而且很新，但需要供电的东西一概不工作。路灯大多是灭的，偶尔会闪一下。
lines.en: Every house is unique, furnished and fairly new, but nothing that needs power works. The street lamps are mostly dead; sometimes one flickers.
lines.tts_text: 房子各不相同，家具齐全，而且很新，但需要供电的东西，一概不工作。路灯大多是灭的，偶尔，会闪一下。
lines.direction: Clinical.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「那栋房子……跟对面那栋一模一样。」
lines.en: “That house… is exactly the same as the one across the street.”
lines.tts_text: 那栋房子……跟对面那栋，一模一样。
lines.direction: Unnerved, very quiet, slowing down as he says it.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「人行道上有一堆灰……摸起来像盐。或者糖。」
lines.en: “There's a pile of grey dust on the sidewalk… It feels like salt. Or sugar.”
lines.tts_text: 人行道上有一堆灰……摸起来像盐。或者，糖。
lines.direction: Crouching, curious, rubbing it between his fingers. Not yet afraid.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 在九层，一堆灰色的粉末，标记着一个人曾经站过的地方。
lines.en: On Level 9, a pile of grey dust marks the place where a person once stood.
lines.tts_text: 在九层，一堆灰色的粉末，标记着一个人曾经站过的地方。
lines.direction: Clinical; the tiniest pause before 'a person'.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「手机……怎么回事，画面在花……」
lines.en: “My phone… what's wrong with it, the picture's breaking up…”
lines.tts_text: 手机……怎么回事，画面在花……
lines.direction: Annoyed, tapping the phone, then trailing off as he sees something.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 「邻里守望」：由眼球构成的实体群。它们会干扰录像，摧毁附近的电子设备。
lines.en: “The Neighborhood Watch”: a group of eyeball entities. They interfere with recordings and destroy electronics nearby.
lines.tts_text: 邻里守望。由眼球构成的实体群。它们会干扰录像，摧毁附近的电子设备。
lines.direction: Clinical.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「关灯……关灯……」
lines.en: “Light off… light off…”
lines.tts_text: 关灯……关灯……
lines.direction: Barely audible whisper, fumbling, panicked, crouching behind a car.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 守望者：汽车大小的眼球，以步行的速度漂浮。它的瞳孔会射出光，被照到的活物会化成细细的灰色粉尘。
lines.en: Watchers: eyeballs the size of a car, floating at walking pace. Their pupils fire a light that turns living things into fine grey dust.
lines.tts_text: 守望者。汽车大小的眼球，以步行的速度漂浮。它的瞳孔会射出光，被照到的活物，会化成细细的灰色粉尘。
lines.direction: Clinical, slightly slower than usual.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「它走了……好冷。怎么突然这么冷。」
lines.en: “It's gone… It's cold. Why is it suddenly so cold.”
lines.tts_text: 它走了……好冷。怎么，突然这么冷。
lines.direction: Shaky exhale of relief, then teeth almost chattering; you can hear his breath.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 气温骤降，浓烟一样的雾在街道上蔓延。在九层，雾是一种预兆。
lines.en: A sudden drop in temperature; a smoke-like fog creeping down the streets. On Level 9, fog is an omen.
lines.tts_text: 气温骤降，浓烟一样的雾，在街道上蔓延。在九层，雾，是一种预兆。
lines.direction: Clinical, low.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「那是什么……那是……一根柱子？」
lines.en: “What is that… is that… a pillar?”
lines.tts_text: 那是什么……那是……一根柱子？
lines.direction: Looking up and up, voice going small.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 「残形者」。最早的目击者描述它是「一根巨大的黑色柱子，一直伸到看不见的地方」。它大到会制造自己的天气。
lines.en: “The Mangled.” The first witness described “a massive black pillar, reaching up far out of sight.” It is large enough to make its own weather.
lines.tts_text: 残形者。最早的目击者描述它是：一根巨大的黑色柱子，一直伸到看不见的地方。它大到，会制造自己的天气。
lines.direction: Clinical; quote the witness flatly.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「跑……快跑……」
lines.en: “Run… run…”
lines.tts_text: 跑……快跑……
lines.direction: To himself, running, gasping between words.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.subtitle: 「路牌……有箭头……」
lines.en: “A sign… there's an arrow…”
lines.tts_text: 路牌……有箭头……
lines.direction: Out of breath, a flicker of hope.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 沿着带箭头的路牌走一百到两百英里，可以到达 Level 11。
lines.en: Following the arrow signs for one to two hundred miles leads to Level 11.
lines.tts_text: 沿着带箭头的路牌，走一百到两百英里，可以到达 Level 11。
lines.direction: Clinical.

lines.speaker: bart_last
lines.subtitle: 「我跟着路牌走。如果有人看到这个——」
lines.en: “I'm following the signs. If anyone sees this—”
lines.tts_text: 我跟着路牌走。如果有人看到这个——
lines.direction: Determined but shaking; cut off mid-sentence by the corruption.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 这是 Bart0nius 的最后一条帖子。「探险者」小组至今下落不明。
lines.en: This was Bart0nius's last post. The Explorers have never been found.
lines.tts_text: 这是巴特的最后一条帖子。探险者小组，至今下落不明。
lines.direction: Clinical, but let the last sentence sit.
